notes: Square M=N=K=n sweep (bench_gemm_main.cpp defaults M/K to --n when --m/--k are not given), so the whole ladder + the cuBLAS ceiling reference share one problem size per sweep point -- see src/kernels/gemm/README.md for what each rung changes. Input range [-1,1); GEMM-specific correctness tolerance (looser than the repo default -- see apps/bench_gemm_main.cpp's kGemmAtol/kGemmRtol doc comment for why: fp32 accumulation-order variance across the ladder's differently-shaped K-loops, not a bug). cublas_sgemm_ceiling is measured and committed alongside V1-V4 but is NEVER included in the ladder's rung-over-rung speedup arithmetic (spec FR2: 'cuBLAS is a ceiling/reference, never a target to beat') -- see docs/decisions/0013-cublas-ceiling-methodology.md.
